title: Focus-wheel preparation review
instruction: Make one focused correction to the saved wheel interface. Its result grouping incorrectly reads output.block_id via an unsafe unknown cast, causing all actual outputs to appear under Other process results while engineering stage sections claim no results. The public OutputRef contract exposes step_id, port_id, result_id, role, title, representations, assessments and supported_viewers. Use output.step_id directly for each existing GEOMETRY/SLICING/INSPECTION grouping. Remove the unknown/block_id cast entirely. Preserve other public controls, manifests, capabilities, bindings, all actual cards and honest engineering limitations. Retain WorkingControls and current snapshot/readOnly contract. Add no executor or hardcoded measurements. Keep App.tsx below 100 lines. Return required source/manifest JSON only.
